Beautiful painterly polished game production art, less pixelated, absolutely no pixel art.
Asset type: landscape playable arena background, 1536x1024.

Warm illuminated paving contrasts with teal waterways and green foliage.
Constraints: no characters, enemies, sprites, interfaces, HUD, UI, text, lettering, signs, logos, watermarks, sky, horizon, or large barriers in the gameplay paths. Render a finished detailed hand-painted background filling the entire landscape image.

Uniformly scale each entire sprite as necessary; maintain each complete body, staff, feet, legs, branches and base. At least 120 pixels of transparent empty space between top and bottom row sprites. Exactly six separate objects centered in these six cells.
